content: Amakeerenʼya
Ɨnyarʉbha yɨnʉ nandikirɨ inyɨ Paaurʉ, hamwɨmwɨ na Timoseo, omohocha ʉmʉkɨndichanɨ wa Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ. Tʉrabhaandɨkɨra abhaangariri na abhasakirya bha risengerero, na niimwɨ abharɨndu
abhandɨ bha Mungu bha Firipi bhanʉ mugwataniibhwɨ na Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ.
Ɨbhɨgʉngi no omorembe kurwa kwa Bhaabha Mungu, na kʉMʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, bhɨbhɨ na niimwɨ.
Paaurʉ arasabhɨra Abhafiripi
Ribhaga ryʉsi hanʉ nɨkʉbhahiita, nɨrakumya Mungu, Ʉmʉkʉrʉ waanɨ.
Ribhaga ryʉsi hanʉ nɨkʉbhasabhɨra, nɨrasabha kobhozomerwa,
kʉ kʉbha imwɨ mugwatɨɨnɨ na niinyɨ kʉraganʼya Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu, kwɨma urusikʉ rʉnʉ mwigwirɨ na kwisirirya kuhika reero.
Nɨna amaheene kʉbha Mungu wʉnʉ aatangirɨ emeremo ɨmɨzʉmu mozekoro zaanyu, aragɨkaja kuhika gɨnagɨ urusikʉ rʉnʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ akʉgarʉka.

Nɨ‑bhwaheene niseegebhu igʉrʉ waanyu imwʉsi, kʉ kʉbha nɨbhasɨɨgirɨ bhʉkʉngʼu. Mʉragwatana kʉbhɨgʉngi bhya Mungu hamwɨmwɨ na niinyɨ, arɨɨbhɨ nɨbhʉhirwɨ mokebhoho hamwɨ arɨɨbhɨ niriibhagɨra na komenyeekererya Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu.
Mungu amɨnyirɨ nɨragamba amaheene hanʉ nɨkʉkandikija kʉbha, niriigomba bhʉkʉngʼu kurumana na niimwɨ kwikɨ. Nɨbhasɨɨgirɨ imwɨ kʉbhʉsɨɨgi bhuryabhurya, bhʉnʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ anabhwɨ.
Nɨrabhasabhɨra kwa Mungu, ʉbhʉsɨɨgi bhwanyu bhʉkajɨ kwaruha bhʉkʉngʼu, na mʉbhɨ na amangʼɨɨni nu ubhwʉbhʉʉri,
korereke mobhone kwobhoora ge enzobhooro. Hayo neho mʉrɨɨbhɨ bhagʉrʉrʉku na mʉtaana isoro, kuhika urusikʉ rʉnʉ Kiriisitʉ akʉgarʉka.
Chɨmbu ʉmʉtɨ guhiibhʉra imisumʉ, na niimwɨ nɨmbu mʉbhakorere abhakɨndichanyu amangʼana amazʉmu chɨmbu Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉgʉngʉ nu ubhukumya bhwa Mungu.
Ubhwikari ne‑komohokerya Kiriisitʉ
Mmbe, abhahiiri bhaanɨ, nereenda momenye bhwaheene kʉbha gʉʉsi ganʉ gambwɨnɨ, gasakiiryɨ bhʉkʉngʼu kʉraarɨka Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu.
Abhariibhi bhʉʉsi bhi inyumba yʉ ʉbhʉtɨmi, hamwɨmwɨ na abhandɨ bhʉʉsi, bhamɨnyirɨ nɨbhʉhirwɨ kʉ kʉbha nɨrahokerya Kiriisitʉ.

Hamwɨmwɨ na gayo, nɨmɨnyirɨ okobhohwa kwanɨ ɨnʉ, kʉbhakʉrirɨ abhiisirirya abhakɨndichɨtʉ bhaaru bhanagɨ imyʉyʉ kʉMʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu, kʉ kʉnaga kuyo bhakarwazɨra abhaatʉ ɨngʼana ya Mungu kʉmanaga gʉʉsi, bhataana bhwʉbha.
Nɨ‑maheene bhareho abhandɨ bhanʉ bhakurwaza ɨngʼana ya Kiriisitʉ kʉ kʉbha bharandorera rihari na bharahizana na niinyɨ. Nʉʉrʉbhu, bhareho abhandɨ bhanʉ bhakurwaza kubhwɨndi ʉbhʉzʉmu.
Bhanʉ bharakorabhu kʉbhʉsɨɨgi, ɨnʉ bhɨɨzɨ bhwaheene kʉbha nɨtɨɨrwɨ mokebhoho korereke nɨbhagɨrɨ Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu.
Nawe abhandɨ, bhararwaza ɨngʼana ya Kiriisitʉ kwɨ ɨkɨnyawɨɨtʉ, na ɨtarɨ kwa mwʉyʉ mwɨrʉ. Bhareenda kwongera ɨnyaakʉ yaanɨ mokebhoho.
Nawe ɨranyahaarakɨ? Ɨngʼana ya Kiriisitʉ ɨrarwazibhwa, ɨbhɨ kubhwɨndi ʉbhʉbhɨ hamwɨ kubhwɨndi ʉbhʉzʉmu. Na niinyɨ kʉ kʉbha ya ringʼana riyo nɨrazomerwa. Na nɨrakaja kʉbha no obhozomerwa.
Nɨmɨnyirɨ kʉbha mwagʉʉsi ganʉ gambwɨnɨ, nɨrasabhurwa, kʉ kʉbha mʉnsabhiirɨ kwa Mungu, ne Ekoro Ɨndɨndu
ya Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ ɨransankirya.

Niriisega kobhoono kʉrʉ na kwisega nɨtakʉsʉʉka kʉnzɨra yʉyʉʉsi. Nangʉ chɨmbu yaarɨ zisikʉ zʉʉsi, nɨrakaja kwikongʼeererya mumwʉyʉ kwa bhʉkararu, korereke Kiriisitʉ akumibhwɨ kwa gʉʉsi ganʉ nekokora, ɨbhɨ kʉsaaga mʉhʉru hamwɨ kukwa.
Nɨrasaagɨ mʉhʉru, ʉbhʉhʉru bhwanɨ bhʉrabha bhwo okomomenya, kʉmʉsɨɨga, komohokerya na kumukurya Kiriisitʉ. Na nɨraakwɨ, kukwa kwanɨ ni‑bhwera bhʉkʉngʼu.
Nawe nɨraakajɨ kwikara kʉʉsɨ, nɨrakaja korora imisumʉ je emeremo gɨnʉ nekokora. Nangʉ nerobhore ryahe? Inyɨ nɨtɨɨzɨ!
Nɨrarutwa gatɨ wa amangʼana abhɨrɨ. Nereenda kurwa kʉʉsɨ hanʉ, niikarɨ hamwɨmwɨ na Kiriisitʉ. Rɨnʉ neryo nekorora rizʉmu kwa niinyɨ.
Nawe, nɨ‑bhwaheene bhʉkʉngʼu inyɨ nengʼehe kwikara kʉʉsɨ igʉrʉ waanyu.
Nene eheene ya ringʼana riyo, nɨɨzɨ nɨrakaja kwikara kʉʉsɨ. Na nɨrabha hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ imwʉsi, korereke nɨbhasakiryɨ mʉkʉrɨ mubhwisirirya bhwanyu na kʉbha no obhozomerwa.
Hanʉ nɨkʉbha hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ, mʉrazomerwa bhʉkʉngʼu ku ukugwatana na Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, kʉ kʉbha arabha ansakiiryɨ nɨgarʉkɨ kwa niimwɨ.

Mmbe, eteemwa yanyu ɨrɨngʼaanɨ nɨ Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu igʉrʉ wa Kiriisitʉ. Korereke hanʉ nikuuza kʉbharora hamwɨ nɨraatamɨ kuuza, niigwɨ muriimɨɨrɨrɨra bhwɨma kubhwigwani, kwa mwʉyʉ gʉmwɨ na kʉbha mʉrɨ hamwɨmwɨ mʉranyaakɨra ubhwisirirya bhʉnʉ bhukurwa kwɨ Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu.
Mʉtʉʉbhaha abhabhisa bhaanyu kwingʼana ryʉryʉsi. Yiyo ɨrabherekeererya ebho bhararichwa, nawe imwɨ mʉrasabhurwa. Gayo gʉʉsi ne‑meremo ja Mungu.
Mʉtahɨɨrwɨ kumwisirirya Kiriisitʉ ukwene, nawe mʉhɨɨrwɨ nʉ ʉkʉnyaakibhwa igʉrʉ waazɨ.
Muriitana na ganʉ naarɨ kwitana nagʉ, chɨmbu mwarʉʉzɨ. Na nangwɨnʉ muriigwa kʉbha nɨrakaja kwitana nagʉ.
